ser|verb|.note: notes: append ' Preterite fui, fue, fueron are shared with ir (Fue un buen día = It was a good day; Fue a casa = He went home).' because these forms are listed for ser but are also ir forms, a common beginner trap.

por|prep|.note: s2: replace 'Por favor, ven aquí.' / 'Please come here.' with 'Te lo envío [por] correo.' / 'I'll send it to you by mail.' because 'por favor' is a fixed phrase that does not show the glossed sense, and no sentence covers the 'by' sense in the gloss.

se|pron|.note: s3: replace 'Ella se va mañana.' / 'She's leaving tomorrow.' with 'Ella [se] mira en el espejo.' / 'She looks at herself in the mirror.' because no sentence shows the glossed reflexive sense (himself/herself) where English actually has the reflexive; 'irse' is a separate idiomatic use.

estar|verb|.note: s4: replace 'Estamos listos.' / 'We're ready.' with 'La tienda [estaba] cerrada.' / 'The shop was closed.' because all four sentences are present tense; variety needs a past form (estaba is already in forms).

su|det|.note: s3: replace '¿Es su coche?' / 'Is it his car?' with 'Señora, ¿es [su] coche?' / 'Ma'am, is this your car?' because without context su is ambiguous (his/her/your) and no sentence shows the glossed formal 'your' sense; the vocative makes it unambiguous.

ir|verb|.note: s1: replace 'Voy a casa.' / 'I'm going home.' with 'Ayer [fui] al médico.' / 'Yesterday I went to the doctor.' because all four sentences are present/infinitive and the past is a core form (fui is already in forms; voy stays covered by the notes and s3's pattern); notes: append ' fui and fue are also forms of ser (fue un buen día = it was a good day).' because they are listed under both verbs.

como|adv|.note: notes: append ' Como is also the yo form of comer: como pan (I eat bread).' because the identical form is a very common trap for beginners; s2: replace 'Haz como yo.' with 'Hazlo [como] yo.' (translation unchanged: 'Do as I do.') because bare 'Haz como yo' sounds clipped; 'Hazlo como yo' is the natural phrasing.

todo|pron|.note: s2: replace 'Todos mis amigos están aquí.' / 'All my friends are here.' with '[Todos] quieren venir.' / 'Everyone wants to come.' because the entry is pos pron but s2 and s3 both use todo as a determiner before a noun; notes: add 'Also before a noun: toda la semana (all week), todos mis amigos (all my friends).' so the remaining determiner use in s3 is explained.

poder|verb|.note: s2: replace 'No puedo dormir.' / 'I can't sleep.' with 'Ayer no [pudo] venir.' / 'He couldn't come yesterday.' because s1 and s2 repeat the same form (puedo) and all sentences are present; pudo is already in forms.

querer|verb|.note: s1: replace 'Quiero ir a casa.' / 'I want to go home.' with 'Ella [quería] ir a casa.' / 'She wanted to go home.' because s1 and s3 repeat the same form (quiero) and all sentences are present; quería is already in forms.
